name: Miranda
note: Fashion, celebrity beauty and destination weddings. Over ten years in the craft.

name: Yuki
note: Bridal experience, technical precision and training in Hong Kong and South Korea.

name: Mira
note: Chinese elegance interpreted through a modern bridal eye.

name: Angelina
note: Fresh, refined bridal, editorial and commercial beauty.

name: Elaine
note: Bridal, portraits and special occasions with the person at the centre.

observation.title: Sleek shape. Soft finish.
notes: A sleek side part flows into a low bun, with pearl-like accents above the ear and across the gathered hair.
Separated lashes and a fine outward eye line sit beside softly highlighted cheeks and a muted pink lip.

name: Emily
note: A thoughtful, detail-oriented approach to personal beauty.

observation.title: A softer frame.
notes: A rounded side-swept fringe crosses the forehead, while loose curled strands frame both sides of the jaw.
Rosy cheeks and a glossy pink lip pair with softly shaded eyes and a fine lifted outer line.

name: Michelle
note: A calm, attentive approach to the features and the occasion.

observation.title: Volume, with warmth.
notes: A deep side part and lifted crown lead into loose, broad curls that fall over one shoulder.
Peach-pink eye shading and soft brows keep the eye area light, paired with a warm coral lip and a subtle cheek flush.

name: Giselle
note: Modern Western and Thai-inspired beauty, sculpted features and radiant skin.
